# 独立退休卸职技术探针；仅在可丢弃 debug 局由皇帝报告者调用。
# 前置：tca_ro_office 为有效官署，tca_ro_original 为真实原任。
# 输出：tca_ro_actor、tca_ro_family、tca_ro_liege；只暂借该官署，不触碰辖区头衔。
# 原任和原领主受临时死亡保护；临时人物由已有夹具建立合法家门与天朝附庸关系。
tca_test_prepare_retirement_office_actor_effect = {
    scope:tca_ro_original = {
        tca_test_protect_character_effect = yes
        # 原任暂离实职的70日内不能被首次补位选作第二官署，归还资格由夹具负责保留。
        # 两职初始池明确读取此旗标；只撤销本例添加的部分，不改真实历史人物标记。
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_character_flag = tca_history_defined_character } }
            add_character_flag = tca_ro_history_owned
            add_character_flag = tca_history_defined_character
        }
    }
    scope:tca_ro_office.holder.liege = {
        save_scope_as = tca_ro_liege
        # 借出与归还相隔105日；原领主死亡后不得再向其执行效忠事务。
        # 使用独立所有权，避免撤掉框架或其他夹具已持有的保护。
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_trait = tca_test_death_protection } }
            add_character_flag = tca_ro_liege_protection_owned
            add_trait = tca_test_death_protection
        }
    }
    tca_test_create_merit_interface_character_effect = { CHARACTER = tca_ro_actor GOVERNMENT = celestial_government }
    scope:tca_ro_actor = {
        tca_test_add_native_merit_probe_exams_effect = yes
        add_trait = education_stewardship_1
        change_merit = 24000
        scope:tca_merit_probe_new_family = { save_scope_as = tca_ro_family }
        create_title_and_vassal_change = { type = granted add_claim_on_loss = no save_scope_as = tca_ro_change }
        scope:tca_ro_office = { change_title_holder = { holder = scope:tca_ro_actor change = scope:tca_ro_change } }
        resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:tca_ro_change
        create_title_and_vassal_change = { type = swear_fealty add_claim_on_loss = no save_scope_as = tca_ro_fealty }
        change_liege = { liege = scope:tca_ro_liege change = scope:tca_ro_fealty }
        resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:tca_ro_fealty
        change_government = celestial_government
        tca_ensure_official_contract_effect = yes
    }
}

# 皇帝报告者作用域；不用于证明自然继任，仅在全部业务检查后精确交还借用头衔。
# 输出：原任重新持有 tca_ro_office；原生头衔回调负责分权与契约，调用者须真实等候。
# 若卸职接口没有交出官署，仍执行相同归还，不把失败留给后续用例。
tca_test_restore_retirement_office_effect = {
    if = { limit = { scope:tca_ro_original = { is_alive = yes } scope:tca_ro_liege = { is_alive = yes } }
        scope:tca_ro_original = {
            if = { limit = { has_character_flag = tca_ro_history_owned }
                remove_character_flag = tca_history_defined_character
                remove_character_flag = tca_ro_history_owned
            }
            create_title_and_vassal_change = { type = granted add_claim_on_loss = no save_scope_as = tca_ro_restore }
            scope:tca_ro_office = { change_title_holder = { holder = scope:tca_ro_original change = scope:tca_ro_restore } }
            resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:tca_ro_restore
            create_title_and_vassal_change = { type = swear_fealty add_claim_on_loss = no save_scope_as = tca_ro_restore_fealty }
            change_liege = { liege = scope:tca_ro_liege change = scope:tca_ro_restore_fealty }
            resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:tca_ro_restore_fealty
        }
    }
    else = {
        add_character_flag = tca_test_$GROUP$_case_failed
        debug_log = "TCA_RETIREMENT_OFFICE RESTORE_DEAD_PARTICIPANT"
    }
    scope:tca_ro_liege = {
        if = { limit = { is_alive = yes has_character_flag = tca_ro_liege_protection_owned }
            remove_trait = tca_test_death_protection
            remove_character_flag = tca_ro_liege_protection_owned
        }
    }
    scope:tca_ro_actor = { tca_test_cleanup_retirement_exit_actor_effect = yes }
}

# 候选技术事务，尚非正式退休实现。人物作用域，必须为实际在任者。
# 先封闭自己继任，再逐署读取真实 current_heir；不自行评分、生成继任者或调用维护 worker。
# 真实继承人有效时使用原生 appointment 事务；否则显式 granted 回交实际领主，
# 由头衔回调自然排队补位。回交上级不是已完成合法继任，调用者须等待并检查最终状态。
# 通判复用正式旧分权解除接口，保留官署双向绑定与经费档位；提刑不销毁官署。
# 输出：tca_ro_candidate_heir／tca_ro_candidate_liege 是最后处理官署的真实快照。
tca_retirement_candidate_step_down_offices_effect = {
    # 身份先退出，防止交回上级后的首次纠错补位再次选回本人。
    tca_retirement_candidate_enter_effect = { TRAIT = tca_retirement_probe_fengci }
    set_appointment_timeout = { years = 150 desc = appointment_timeout_desc_refusing }
    save_scope_as = tca_ro_candidate_retiring
    every_held_title = {
        limit = { OR = { has_variable = tca_tongpan_title has_variable = tca_judicial_title } }
        save_scope_as = tca_ro_candidate_title
        holder.liege = { save_scope_as = tca_ro_candidate_liege }
        clear_saved_scope = tca_ro_candidate_heir
        current_heir ?= {
            if = {
                limit = {
                    is_alive = yes is_adult = yes is_available = yes is_landed = no
                    this != scope:tca_ro_candidate_retiring
                    appointment_timeout_days = 0
                    NOT = { any_held_title = { is_noble_family_title = no } }
                }
                save_scope_as = tca_ro_candidate_heir
            }
        }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = tca_tongpan_title } tca_stop_tongpan_diarchy_effect = yes }
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:tca_ro_candidate_heir }
            scope:tca_ro_candidate_heir = {
                create_title_and_vassal_change = { type = appointment add_claim_on_loss = no save_scope_as = tca_ro_candidate_change }
                scope:tca_ro_candidate_title = { change_title_holder = { holder = scope:tca_ro_candidate_heir change = scope:tca_ro_candidate_change } }
                resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:tca_ro_candidate_change
            }
            debug_log = "TCA_RETIREMENT_OFFICE CANDIDATE_NATIVE_HEIR"
        }
        else = {
            scope:tca_ro_candidate_liege = {
                create_title_and_vassal_change = { type = granted add_claim_on_loss = no save_scope_as = tca_ro_candidate_change }
                scope:tca_ro_candidate_title = { change_title_holder = { holder = scope:tca_ro_candidate_liege change = scope:tca_ro_candidate_change } }
                resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:tca_ro_candidate_change
            }
            debug_log = "TCA_RETIREMENT_OFFICE CANDIDATE_RETURN_TO_LIEGE"
        }
    }
}
